coordinate_contract.projection: x,y,w,h times2/3; an explicit own adaptation, not a native layout measurement.
coordinate_contract.composition: row-vector point*local*parent, using cached decoded matrices. Shape bounds use four_ints; text uses text_header.bounds_xywh. No adding origins without affine composition.
coordinate_contract.static_limit: Replay root records0..label sequentially; recurse only each sprite first local record. Does not execute GoToLabel, native mutations, child animation, alpha rasterization or clipping. Rects are transformed canvas quads, not opaque ink or clickable hit rectangles.
